reference.shortdesc: The task element is the top-level element for a task topic. Task topics provide the instructions that guide people to perform a task.

section.title: Usage information
section.p: The OASIS DITA Technical Committee distributes two document-type shells for task topics: general task and strict task. See for more information on the different shells.

section.title: Specialization hierarchy
section.p: The task element is specialized from topic. It is defined in the task module.
